spans.s: गाथा f. 1. A verse; 2. verse, which, though religious, does not belong to any of the Vedas; 3. a prākṛt dialect.
गाथक m. 1. A musician, a singer; 2. a chanter of sacred poems.
गाथक m. 1. A musician, a singer; 2. a chanter of sacred poems.
गाथिका f. A song, a verse, Yaj.i.45.
गाथा-कार m. a writer of Prākṛt verses.
